verdicts.rationale: In libs/payments/batch.py, replacing parallel authorization calls (asyncio.gather(*[authorize(i) for i in items])) with an async Batcher context manager (async with Batcher(**settings.payments_batch)) introduces batch collection delays and request serialization on payment gateway calls. This directly explains the p99 latency burn on POST /api/checkout/pay rising to 2.4s while 5xx error rates remain baseline.

In services/checkout/http.py, caching a single httpx.AsyncClient via @lru_cache def _shared_client() forces all checkout HTTP requests to share one client instance. Under high concurrency, default HTTP connection pool limits cause request queuing latency on outbound calls, contributing to elevated latency.

In deploy/checkout.yaml, increasing worker count from 8 to 16 could cause CPU context switching or resource contention, but is unlikely to be the primary cause of a 3x latency increase on POST /api/checkout/pay without causing errors.
